title: ONE LIGHT OUT
hints: Look at the light sources.
One source is dark.
Only two directions leave each Post.

title: SWITCH
hints: Another lamp is within reach.
Try looking under the other light.
The same Posts must explain both views.

title: DOUBLE EXPOSURE
hints: Touch the side lamps.
Compare what stays and what changes.
The vertical shadows remain in both views.

title: SHUTTER
hints: Follow the light above the board.
A plate interrupts one column.
That column still receives light from the sides.

title: FOURTH LIGHT
hints: Look below the board.
A fourth source is shining upward.
One Post casts in all four directions.

title: TALL POST
hints: Look at the shape of the Post.
Watch the shadow extend when you place it.
Each light reaches two cells from this Post.

title: WHICH LIGHT?
hints: The Posts are seated in place.
The lamps respond to your touch.
Which source produces the extra shadows?

title: MOVE THE SHUTTER
hints: The plate rests on a rail.
Slide it and watch the vertical shadows.
Block only the column with an unwanted downward shadow.

title: TWO KINDS OF UNKNOWN
hints: There are two kinds of movable object.
Use the side shadows to locate the Posts.
Then compare the downward shadows and move the plate.

title: PARALLAX
hints: Look at the same arrangement under both lamps.
Separate the shadows that change from those that stay.
Side shadows locate Posts; the missing downward shadow locates the plate.
